name: energy_capacity_kwh
description: Usable energy capacity of the battery

name: max_charge_kw
description: Maximum charging power (power drawn from the grid)

name: max_discharge_kw
description: Maximum discharging power (power exported to the grid)

name: charge_efficiency
description: Share of the energy drawn for charging that is stored (0 to 1)

name: discharge_efficiency
description: Share of the stored energy removed for discharging that reaches the grid (0 to 1)

name: initial_soc_kwh
description: Energy stored in the battery at the start of the day

name: terminal_soc_kwh
description: Least energy that must be stored at the end of the day
